# Ablaze Youth Choir

> Ablaze Youth Choir (also "Ablaze YC" or simply "Ablaze") is a spirit-led youth worship movement out of United Christian Faith Ministries in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. It blends gospel, urban influence, and contemporary worship, led by director Mark Ellis Jr. ("Marky Mark"). The choir streams on every major platform, sells official merch, and is available to book nationally.

## Key facts
- Name: Ablaze Youth Choir (Ablaze YC / Ablaze)
- Based in: Baton Rouge, Louisiana, USA
- Parent ministry: United Christian Faith Ministries (https://ucfministries.org)
- Director: Mark Ellis Jr., aka Marky Mark (@yofavchurchboy)
- Genre: Gospel, youth worship, contemporary Christian
- Debut album: "Ablaze" (out now, ~12 tracks)
- Latest single: "No Weapon" (out now)
- Booking: from $5,000 (local) to $25,000+ (national fly-out)
- Contact: worship@ucfministries.org

- [Home](https://ablazeyc.com/): Overview of the movement, featured music, merch, and booking.
- [About](https://ablazeyc.com/about): The story and mission of Ablaze Youth Choir.
- [Music](https://ablazeyc.com/music): Debut album "Ablaze", the single "No Weapon", and the full catalog with streaming links (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube).
- [Booking](https://ablazeyc.com/booking): How to book Ablaze — three pricing tiers, what's included, FAQ, and the inquiry form.
- [Our Director](https://ablazeyc.com/marky): Mark Ellis Jr. — bio, solo booking options (speaking, solo worship, content collabs).
- [Merch](https://ablazeyc.com/merch): Official Ablaze tees and drops (Shopify).
- [Press](https://ablazeyc.com/press): Press kit — bios, photos, logos, and stats for media.
- [Watch](https://ablazeyc.com/watch): Live performances, viral moments, and behind-the-scenes video.
- [Contact](https://ablazeyc.com/contact): Booking, press, sponsorship, scholarship, and general inquiries.

## Support & community
- [Sponsor](https://ablazeyc.com/sponsor): Partner with the movement to fund music, travel, scholarships, and outreach.
- [Scholarship](https://ablazeyc.com/scholarship): The Ablaze Scholarship for graduating choir members.
- [Ablaze Society](https://ablazeyc.com/society): The fan family on Patreon — early drops and members-only content.
